Laguna Beach Residences Bayside

Condominium in Laguna Phuket (Bang Tao)
HomeSaleLaguna Beach Residences Bayside

Images from Keller Henson and Papaya Property developer marketing materials. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Laguna Beach Residences Bayside is a low-rise condominium within the Laguna Phuket master plan at Bang Tao, a development of the Banyan Group. Listings describe apartments from about 73 sqm up to penthouses of roughly 359 sqm.

Sources disagree on the exact number of units (234 to 237) and on the completion date (between Q2 and Q4 2028), so we show only the year. A payment plan of five 20% steps tied to signing, construction progress and completion appears in one listing; confirm it with us before relying on it.

Prices differ between sources. The starting price shown is the lowest we found; ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list.

Laguna Beach Residences Bayside: key facts

  • Laguna Beach Residences Bayside is a condominium in Laguna Phuket, developed by Banyan Group (Laguna Property).
  • Units: 2–3 bedrooms, 73–359 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Oct 2028.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿25,370,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bang Tao Beach (Near, within Laguna Phuket); Thalang Hospital (5.3 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (5.8 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (1.8 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Banyan Group in our catalogue: Banyan Tree Grand Residences Seaview, Residences at Garrya Phuket, Banyan Tree Beach Residences Nerea.
